name: claude-window-status
description: Prefixes the window title (and taskbar hover preview) with whether a Claude Code session in this workspace is working, waiting on you, or ready.

commands.title: Claude Window Status: Clear status for this window

claudeWindowStatus.updateTitle.description: Prefix window.title with the Claude status. Only applies when a .code-workspace file is open (the title is written to that file's settings).

claudeWindowStatus.prefix.working.description: Title prefix while Claude is working.

claudeWindowStatus.prefix.waiting.description: Title prefix while Claude is waiting on a permission prompt or question.

claudeWindowStatus.prefix.ready.description: Title prefix once Claude has finished its turn.

claudeWindowStatus.staleHours.description: Ignore session status files that haven't changed in this many hours (e.g. a session that was killed).
